LEASE AGREEMENT

AL WAHA BUSINESS PARK (synthetic fixture)

Between Al Waha Development Company (the Landlord) and Northstar Logistics LLC (the Tenant).

1. Premises. The Landlord lets to the Tenant the whole of the business park, with a net lettable area of 60,000 sqm.

2. Term. The lease is granted for a term of ten (10) years from the commencement date.

3. Rent. The Tenant shall pay an annual base rent of SAR 30,000,000 payable quarterly in advance.

4. Escalation. The base rent shall escalate by 4% per annum on each anniversary of the commencement date.
5. Rent-free period. The Tenant is granted a rent-free period of 6 months from the commencement date.

6. Operating costs. The Landlord's operating costs are capped at 20% of the rent received in any lease year.

7. Deposit. The Tenant shall provide a security deposit equal to three months' rent.

Signed on 15 March 2026.
